w04.046.en: …where we already are able to identify the clustering of at least seventy thousand aggregations of matter, each of which is greater than any one of the present superuniverses.

w04.107.en: In other words: At the present moment about ninety-five per cent of the active cosmic-gravity action of the Isle of Paradise, computed on this totality theory, is engaged in controlling material systems beyond the borders of the present organized universes.

w04.134.en: …we regard the master universe as having limitations, as being definitely delimited and bounded on its outer margins by open space.

w05.040.en: …destiny is probably consummated by the act of the Consummator of Universe Destiny, and this act is probably involved with the Supreme and the Ultimate in the Trinity Absolute.

w05.042.en: The Ultimate Trinity, now evolving, will eventually consist of the Supreme Being, the Supreme Creator Personalities, and the absonite Architects of the Master Universe…

w05.045.en: Of this, however, we are certain: While the existential Paradise Trinity is infinite, and while the experiential Trinity Ultimate is subinfinite, the Trinity Absolute is not so easy to classify.
w05.045.why: sentence count en 3 vs es 2 in 106:6.5

w05.086.en: Of all who ascend to the eternal Isle, only those who thus arrive are the children of eternity…

w05.099.en: …but as man ascends, as he progresses inward, the enlarging view of this event procession is such that it is discerned more and more in its wholeness.

w05.115.en: And it would also appear that the unconditioned would also be unlimited, at least from a qualitative standpoint, though we are not so sure regarding quantitative relationships.
w05.115.why: sentence count en 5 vs es 4 in 106:6.4

w05.120.en: If we assume a cosmos-infinite—some illimitable cosmos on beyond the master universe—and if we conceive that the final developments of the Absolute Trinity will take place out on such a superultimate stage of action, …

w05.164.en: These three experiential Deities were potential in the existential Trinity, the Paradise Trinity, but their universe emergence as personalities of power is dependent in part on their own experiential functioning in the universes of power and personality…

w05.166.en: …as is illustrated by the power-personality synthesis now going on in connection with the evolution of the Supreme Being.

w05.175.en: On this supercreative level, Deity experiences exhaustion of personalizable potential, encounters completion of divinity…

w05.179.en: The Ultimate Trinity is experientially unifying in completion, but we truly doubt the possibility of such full unification of the Absolute Trinity. Our concept, however, of the eternal Paradise Trinity is an ever-present reminder that Deity trinitization may accomplish what is otherwise nonattainable…
